job.title: Client Side Project Manager
job.description:
ABOUT THE POSITION.
 
As a Client-Side Project Manager, you will manage projects on behalf of clients, overseeing the process from initial planning and design through to procurement, construction and completion.

You will work closely with clients, consultants and contractors to ensure projects are delivered in line with agreed budgets, programmes and quality expectations.

This role will suit someone with solid client-side experience who is confident managing stakeholders, coordinating project teams and navigating the challenges that come with project delivery.

DUTIES.
  • Manage client-side projects from feasibility and planning through to delivery and handover.
  • Coordinate architects, consultants, contractors and other project stakeholders.
  • Manage project risks, variations, reporting and contractual requirements.
  • Represent the client's interests throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Maintain strong relationships with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Monitor project progress, quality and commercial performance.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment and support the ongoing growth of the business.
THE BENEFITS.
  • Exposure to a varied portfolio of projects across different sectors.
  • Opportunity to take ownership of projects and build your client-side experience.
  • Direct access to senior leadership and experienced project professionals.
  • A close-knit team with a collaborative working environment.
  • Strong pipeline of upcoming projects and opportunities for career progression.
  • Competitive remuneration package based on experience.
ABOUT YOU.
  • Minimum 6 years' experience in client-side project management.
  • Proven experience managing projects on behalf of clients across the project lifecycle.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience coordinating consultants, contractors, budgets and programmes.
  • A proactive approach with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Relevant qualifications in Construction Management, Project Management, Engineering or a related discipline.
If you're an experienced Client-Side Project Manager looking for greater project ownership, varied project exposure and the opportunity to join a growing consultancy, we'd love to hear from you.
